summary: Orbit Lab is a realistic space mission design game created by Astra Vanguard, where you engineer custom rockets and probes to explore distant planets. Launch your spacecraft and navigate through intense challenges, including dodging hazards in the asteroid belt, collecting rock samples, detecting moonquakes, and docking with the International Space Station to deliver your discoveries. Each mission you complete gives research points that you can use to upgrade rocket propulsion, unlock advanced scientific sensors, and expand your orbital launch complex to reach the furthest edges of the solar system.
details: You can access our game by going to the readme files in the given github repo link and clicking on the itch.io url that has been given. The benefits our project has is that it lets players learn about space travel and about how hard it is to do a mission. We used the code language called GD script which is what Godot uses.OUr project is creative since it uses many 3d models and we made the animations that match and we have many special minigames that make each mission harder.We considered how some people PC may be slower.
